configuration: run.sh builds mas from the pinned source (build.sh with conf/sab.conf, gfortran -O2, cached per source digest and build mode under SAB_BUILD_CACHE_ROOT; -O2 rather than upstream's -O3 because the image's gfortran 14.2 on x86_64 vectorises the WTD deck's first velocity solve into NaN at -O3) and runs ic/<ic>/mas.in, the example deck code/mas/examples/corona_thermo_hm2_cr2124_steadystate with the grid reduced from 255x143x300 to 61x51x91 and tmax from 120 to 0.1275 (25.5 x dtmax 0.005), on SAB_MPI_RANKS=4 ranks with SAB_TMAX=0.1275 and SAB_FRAMES=5 (tpltxint and thistint = SAB_TMAX/5). The grid knobs SAB_NR, SAB_NT, SAB_NP default to 61, 51, 91. Graded: the energy history history_a.txt, the first eleven columns of history_b.txt (dt and the CFL columns are excluded) and the 6 frames (t=0, the five interval crossings, the last one coinciding with the run end) of the fields br,bt,bp,vr,vt,vp,rho,t,p,ep,em,heat as fields/<field>_fNN.npy converted from MAS's HDF5 with h5py, plus the mesh coordinates of every field.
observable: the 12-field state (br,bt,bp,vr,vt,vp,rho,t,p,ep,em,heat) at 6 times over the window and the global energy histories, every value
runtime_note: under 300 s: 48 s in the calibration container on the x86 worker (4 cpus, shared host) and 29 s natively on 4 ranks (arm64, gfortran 15); the graded window is 0.1275 MAS time units on the graded grid, all knobs at their defaults
default_vs_upstream: custom: the grid reduced from 255x143x300 to 61x51x91 and tmax from 120 to 0.1275 (25.5 x dtmax 0.005)
variant: ic/variant is ic/nominal with the viscosity visc raised by two ulps of double precision (0.002 to 0.002000000000000001); every graded field moves at the round-off level (measured native spread nominal vs variant, as the needed tolerance max |d|/(|ref|+peak): 4.781e-09), which is exactly the reorder-level perturbation a pointwise bound has to admit while it rejects the faults named in the warrant.
altbuild: run.sh altbuild builds the same pinned source with FRTFLAGS=-O1 instead of the graded -O2 (same mpif90, same HDF5) and runs the nominal deck on it; a correct port compiled without vectorisation or floating-point contraction is a legitimate candidate (measured native spread nominal vs -O1, as the needed tolerance max |d|/(|ref|+peak): 1.500e-08; -O0 measured the same as -O1 to two digits at five times the cost).

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-16: run.sh altbuild (the same pinned source built with FRTFLAGS=-O1 instead of the -O2 of the graded build (same mpif90, same HDF5): no loop vectorisation, a different instruction schedule for the reductions and stencils, the deck and the rank count unchanged; measured natively to have the same spread as -O0 at a fifth of its cost) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: bit-identical output

altbuild.what: the same pinned source built with FRTFLAGS=-O1 instead of the -O2 of the graded build (same mpif90, same HDF5): no loop vectorisation, a different instruction schedule for the reductions and stencils, the deck and the rank count unchanged; measured natively to have the same spread as -O0 at a fifth of its cost

warrant: The check runs the CORHEL thermodynamic coronal relaxation of CR2124 with Heating Model 2 and the closed-field heating mask closed_field_mask_pfss.h5: potential field of the HMI map, initial_plasma_thermo_r1d.dat, conduction, radiation, pressure waves, 25 steps of dtmax 0.005 (tmax 0.1275) on a 61x51x91 grid; it exercises heating model 2 with a heat mask (heating, src/mas.F90:57238), advtce 54877, advpw 59665, advt 41299, advrho 41082 and advv 36556. Every graded value is a double-precision field value at a grid position and a recorded time, or an energy sum at a recorded time, and the bound is |candidate - reference| <= 1e-06 (|reference| + peak |reference| of the file), i.e. 1e-06 of the value with a floor of 1e-06 of the field's own peak where the field crosses zero. It is physical: a wrong mask application, a wrong heating rate or a wrong conduction solve changes t, p, rho and heat where the mask marks closed field, at a level orders of magnitude above 1e-06. It is achievable: two legitimate runs of the pinned build differ only through the floating-point reorder of the preconditioned conjugate-gradient reductions (cgsolve, src/mas.F90:26899, summed with global_sum 46419 over the 4 ranks), the compiler's contraction choices and the solver's own convergence tolerances (epscg 1e-9 in the deck); measured natively, the two-ulp viscosity variant needs 4.781e-09 and the -O1 build 1.500e-08, and in the x86 calibration container the variant needs 1.176e-08 while the -O1 build is bit-identical, so the bound sits 67x above the largest of the three. The spread of this deck is set by the velocity at the last frame (4e-7 of its peak): the semi-implicit velocity solve stops at epscg_v 1e-9 of the residual norm, and a different iteration path lands on a different admissible solution; every port shows the same. The energy histories are printed by MAS with eight significant digits, so no bound below 1e-7 can be met by them once a legitimate run flips their last digit; that sets the floor of the tolerance table.
